title: AI is fueling ransomware growth and helping new groups emerge
teaser: Ransomware attacks are on the rise: some estimates put the number of incidents reported on leak sites over the summer at nearly 3,000, up 20–40% from the spring. Researchers attribute part of the increase to AI: criminals use language models to write phishing emails and negotiate with victims, and are gaining tools to operate on their own. No fully automated AI-driven attacks have been observed yet, but dozens of new groups have emerged in recent months. One claimed 48 victims, another 71 in 20 days.
